title: Tech Trends 2024
notes: 15th annual edition. The edition URL serves the full PDF. Executive summary: the report highlights 'new technologies and approaches that stand to become the norm within 18 to 24 months. We also project where the trends could be headed during the coming decade.' Six trends; the introduction ('Generative AI: Force multiplier for human ambitions') is an essay, not a trend. Quotes are from the executive summary unless noted. published = PDF creation month (December 2023); Deloitte's launch date not checked.

entries.label: Interfaces in new places: Spatial computing and the industrial metaverse
entries.quote: Augmented and virtual reality for consumer applications have garnered a lot of attention, but these technologies are making their biggest impact in industrial settings.
entries.subject: Spatial computing and the industrial metaverse
entries.horizon: next 18 to 24 months; the coming decade
entries.note: Chapter: 'In the next 18 to 24 months, companies should pay attention to the value opportunities for adopting spatial operations'. Third-party market projections in the chapter are not recorded.

entries.label: Genie out of the bottle: Generative AI as growth catalyst
entries.quote: Regardless of whether it possesses intelligence in the philosophical sense, it does in a practical sense, creating the opportunity for huge productivity and efficiency gains in enterprise settings.
entries.subject: Generative AI
entries.horizon: within 18 to 24 months; the coming decade (edition-level)

entries.label: Smarter, not harder: Beyond brute force compute
entries.quote: Typical cloud services still provide more than enough functionality for most business-as-usual operations, but for the cutting-edge use cases that drive competitive advantage, a new need for specialized hardware is emerging.
entries.subject: Specialized compute hardware (AI chips, quantum, neuromorphic)
entries.horizon: within 18 to 24 months; the coming decade (edition-level)

entries.label: From DevOps to DevEx: Empowering the engineering experience
entries.quote: In the years to come, DevEx can lead to a future of integrated, intuitive tools that enable citizen developers across the business to drive tech value.
entries.subject: Developer experience (DevEx)
entries.horizon: within 18 to 24 months; the coming decade (edition-level)

entries.label: Defending reality: Truth in an age of synthetic media
entries.quote: However, leading organizations are responding through a mix of policies and technologies designed to identify harmful content and make their employees more aware of the risks.
entries.subject: Deepfakes and synthetic media defense
entries.horizon: within 18 to 24 months; the coming decade (edition-level)

entries.label: Core workout: From technical debt to technical wellness
entries.quote: In the years to come, companies are likely to develop a highly customized and integrated wellness plan across the tech stack, including investments in self-healing technologies that reduce tomorrow’s modernization needs.
entries.subject: Technical debt and core modernization
entries.horizon: within 18 to 24 months; the coming decade (edition-level)
